race.comment: STANDLEE (1) made it three minor placings from as many runs this prep when he came from next to last on the corner to get up for second over 1350m at Warwick last start. Sean Cormack, with a win and six minors from seven rides on the gelding, is back today. Very fit and bursting to win one. HEADLINE LEGEND (7) was slow out of the gates and couldn't recover last time out over 1100m at Warwick. Getting out to this sort of journey at the third run back should see plenty of improvement. PEACH GALANTES (9) led and gave a tremendous sight but found a couple better close to home recently over this trip at Dalby. Not a prolific winner but should give backers a thrill again with the light weight. CALVARY (3) made a rare visit to the winner's stall last start over 1200m at Kilcoy. Not getting too excited by that success but he deserves a spot in exotic wagers. SOUTHOFTHEBORDER (6) ran a nice race off a five-week let-up at Warwick last time. Room for further improvement.
